title: Brewfather Coffee Recipe Failure Rate
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brewfather:coffee
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(batch_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by recipe_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Brewfather coffee recipe records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each recipe name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize batch_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per recipe name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which parts of your Brewfather coffee recipe data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
